product.description: The Monoprice Cat5e Patch Cable, UTP, 24AWG, 350MHz, Pure Bare Copper, Snagless RJ45, Fullboot Series Ethernet Cable is a high‑quality networking solution designed to provide reliable and fast connectivity for your devices. With its impressive features and adherence to strict safety standards, this Ethernet cable ensures superior performance and peace of mind.Featuring Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP) Category 5e technology, this cable guarantees efficient transmission of data signals without any interference. The 24AWG stranded, pure bare copper conductors ensure optimal conductivity and signal integrity, allowing for seamless and uninterrupted data transfer.To further enhance its performance, the Monoprice Ethernet cable is equipped with 50µm gold plated contacts. These contacts not only provide excellent signal transmission but also offer superior resistance against corrosion, ensuring long‑lasting performance and durability.With a bandwidth of 350MHz, this cable is capable of supporting high‑speed data transfers, making it ideal for demanding applications such as streaming, online gaming, and large file transfers. Whether you are connecting your computer, gaming console, printer, or any other Ethernet‑enabled device, this cable delivers fast and stable connectivity.One of the standout features of this cable is its snagless cable boot, which protects the plug retaining clip. This design prevents accidental disconnections and minimizes cable damage, ensuring a reliable and secure connection at all times. You can enjoy hassle‑free networking without worrying about loose connections or interrupted signals.The full‑boot connectors of this Ethernet cable provide additional protection and durability. They shield the delicate connection points from strain and damage, making the cable more robust and long‑lasting. This feature ensures that the cable can withstand the rigors of daily use and remain in excellent condition for an extended period.Monoprice takes pride in its commitment to safety and quality. The Ethernet cables in the Fullboot Series are constructed using 100% pure bare copper wire, exceeding industry expectations for performance and reliability. The use of pure bare copper ensures compliance with UL® Code 444 and National Electrical Code® TIA‑568‑C.2 fire and safety standards, which require high‑quality conductor materials in communications cables to support safe, consistent, and dependable operation.In summary, the Monoprice Cat5e Patch Cable, UTP, 24AWG, 350MHz, Pure Bare Copper, Snagless RJ45, Fullboot Series Ethernet Cable combines superior performance, durability, and safety. With its UTP Category 5e technology, pure bare copper conductors, gold plated contacts, and snagless design, this cable guarantees fast, reliable, and secure connectivity for all your networking needs.
